title: Ask the user for missing acceptance context; never infer or suggest it

facts.note: Planner is authoring or extracting an acceptance (or its wagon/WMBT placement).
Whether any piece of acceptance context (e.g. target wagon) is absent from what the user supplied can only be judged by an LLM today.
Would need a conversation-to-artifact trace observer to detect context filled by guess rather than by a user answer.

fires: Drafting an acceptance and the user has not said which wagon it belongs to.
Any acceptance context needed while extracting the acceptance is absent from the user's request or prior answers.
doesNotFire: All acceptance context being used was explicitly stated by the user.
Work that is not acceptance extraction (e.g. coding against an already-complete acceptance).

given: You are extracting an acceptance and some context (e.g. which wagon it belongs to) is missing from what the user has stated.
when: You need to obtain or fill in that missing context.
then: Obtain the missing context by asking the user directly — do not infer it and do not offer suggestions.
prefer: Pure conversational extraction: ask the user directly about the gap, e.g. the wagon_inference prompt 'Which wagon should this acceptance belong to?'
Wait for the user's answer before writing the context into the acceptance.
avoid: Guessing (inferring) missing acceptance context from surrounding material and writing it in.
Offering suggestions or pre-filled candidate answers instead of asking directly.
why: No inference is the policy of asking rather than guessing missing acceptance context; direct extraction supplies the context the abstract acceptance fields require and keeps the acceptance complete and faithful to the user's intent.
evidence: Every piece of acceptance context that was not in the user's original request traces to a direct question asked of the user and the user's answer.
The conversation contains no inferred values or suggestion lists presented in place of a direct question.
verifier_detail: Term no_inference: the policy of asking rather than guessing missing acceptance context.
Canonical prompt example (wagon_inference): 'Which wagon should this acceptance belong to?'
